strategy.summary: The todo app (static public/app.js, in-memory state per page load, served by server.js) already implements completing, filtering and clearing todos. The tests drive it in a browser with Playwright to prove: ticking strikes a todo through and lowers the "items left" count (unticking reverses it), the All/Active/Completed filters show the right todos and mark the selected one aria-pressed, and "Clear completed" shows only while something is completed and removes every completed todo.
inScope: Completing and un-completing todos via their checkbox (strike-through, items-left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their pressed state
outOfScope: Adding todos beyond what setup needs (covered by tests/add-todo.spec.js)
Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: The real app runs: Playwright's existing webServer starts `node server.js`; nothing is faked (there is no backend API, state lives in the page).
Each test gets a fresh page, so todos never leak between tests or retries; no cleanup is needed.
'Struck through' is asserted as the todo text's computed text-decoration-line being line-through (the visible effect), not by the `completed` CSS class.
Todos are located by role (list 'Todos', listitem, checkbox named by its label text) with exact names.
openQuestions: The repo has no axe-core dependency; an automated accessibility scan is not part of this ticket's cases.

risks.description: Count not updated or struck-through state not reverted on untick
risks.mitigation: TC1 and TC2 assert both the style and the exact count text in both directions

risks.description: Filter shows wrong items, or pressed state stays on the old filter
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert the exact list contents and aria-pressed on all three buttons; TC8 checks the Active view updates on completion

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos or stays visible with nothing completed
risks.mitigation: TC6 covers visibility both ways, TC7 checks only completed todos are removed and the button hides

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: it is struck through and the items-left count goes down by one; unticking reverses both.
The Active filter shows only non-completed todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" is shown only while at least one todo is completed, and removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and lowers the items left count
preconditions: App open with todos 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog' added (2 items left)
testCases.expected: Checkbox checked; 'Buy milk' text has text-decoration-line line-through; 'Walk dog' not struck through; count reads '1 item left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores the count
preconditions: Two todos added, 'Buy milk' ticked (1 item left)
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked; text-decoration-line is none; count reads '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is pressed
testCases.expected: List items exactly ['Walk dog']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
testCases.expected: List items exactly ['Buy milk']; Completed pressed, others not

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk' (completed) and 'Walk dog'; Completed filter selected
testCases.expected: List items exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog']; All pressed, others not
testCases.rationale: Returning to All restores the full list

testCases.title: Clear completed is shown only while a todo is completed
testCases.expected: Hidden before ticking (todo visible in list), visible after ticking, hidden again after unticking
testCases.rationale: Refusal side: no clear action offered when nothing is completed

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent' added; 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent' ticked
testCases.expected: List items exactly ['Walk dog']; count '1 item left'; Clear completed hidden
testCases.rationale: Removes all, not only one, completed todo and nothing else

testCases.title: ticking a todo while the Active filter is selected removes it from the list
preconditions: Todos 'Buy milk' and 'Walk dog' added; Active selected
testCases.expected: List items exactly ['Walk dog']; count '1 item left'
testCases.rationale: Filter view stays consistent as state changes

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's webServer in playwright.config.js starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (BASE_URL http://localhost:4173). No env vars, seed data or backend needed.
